ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.summary: Sugar is a common sweetener that can contribute to health issues like obesity and diabetes when consumed in excess.
ingredients.details: Sugar is a simple carbohydrate that provides energy but lacks essential nutrients. High consumption is linked to increased risk of chronic conditions such as heart disease and dental cavities.

ingredients.name: Bleached Wheat Flour
ingredients.summary: Bleached wheat flour is refined flour treated with chemicals to improve texture and appearance.
ingredients.details: Bleached wheat flour undergoes chemical processing, which may reduce its nutritional value compared to whole wheat flour. It is often used in processed foods and can contribute to blood sugar spikes.

ingredients.name: Malted Barley Flour
ingredients.summary: Malted barley flour is a natural ingredient used to enhance flavor and improve baking properties.
ingredients.details: This flour is made from sprouted barley grains and is often used in baked goods to improve texture and flavor. It is generally considered safe.

ingredients.name: Niacin
ingredients.summary: Niacin is a B-vitamin essential for energy production and maintaining healthy skin and nerves.
ingredients.details: Niacin (Vitamin B3) is added to fortified foods to prevent deficiencies. It plays a role in converting food into energy and supports overall health.

ingredients.name: Reduced Iron
ingredients.summary: Reduced iron is a mineral used to fortify foods and prevent iron deficiency anemia.
ingredients.details: Iron is essential for oxygen transport in the blood. Fortified foods often include reduced iron to help meet dietary needs, especially in populations prone to deficiency.

ingredients.name: Ferrous Sulfate
ingredients.summary: Ferrous sulfate is a form of iron used in food fortification to prevent iron deficiency.
ingredients.details: This mineral is commonly added to processed foods to improve iron content. It is safe in recommended amounts but can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in excess.

ingredients.name: Thiamine Mononitrate
ingredients.summary: Thiamine mononitrate is a synthetic form of Vitamin B1 used to fortify foods.
ingredients.details: Vitamin B1 is essential for energy metabolism and nerve function. Fortification helps prevent deficiencies, especially in populations consuming refined grains.

ingredients.name: Riboflavin
ingredients.summary: Riboflavin is a B-vitamin that supports energy production and overall health.
ingredients.details: Also known as Vitamin B2, riboflavin is important for cellular function and metabolism. It is often added to fortified foods to prevent deficiencies.

ingredients.name: Folic Acid
ingredients.summary: Folic acid is a synthetic form of folate, a B-vitamin essential for DNA synthesis and cell growth.
ingredients.details: Folic acid is commonly added to fortified foods to prevent neural tube defects during pregnancy and support overall health. It is safe and beneficial in recommended amounts.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.summary: Water is a natural ingredient used as a base or solvent in food products.
ingredients.details: Water is essential for hydration and is commonly used in food preparation. It poses no health risks.

ingredients.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
ingredients.summary: High fructose corn syrup is a sweetener linked to obesity and metabolic disorders.
ingredients.details: This processed sweetener is made from corn starch and contains high levels of fructose. It is associated with increased risk of diabetes, heart disease, and liver issues when consumed excessively.

ingredients.name: Palm Oil
ingredients.summary: Palm oil is a widely used vegetable oil that may contribute to health and environmental concerns.
ingredients.details: Palm oil is high in saturated fats, which can raise cholesterol levels if consumed in excess. Its production is also linked to deforestation and habitat destruction.

ingredients.name: Corn Syrup
ingredients.summary: Corn syrup is a sweetener that can contribute to blood sugar spikes and weight gain.
ingredients.details: Corn syrup is made from corn starch and is used to add sweetness to foods. While less concentrated than high fructose corn syrup, it can still contribute to health issues when consumed excessively.

ingredients.name: Cocoa
ingredients.summary: Cocoa is a natural ingredient derived from cacao beans and used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: Cocoa is rich in antioxidants and can provide health benefits when consumed in moderation. It is commonly used in chocolate and baked goods.

ingredients.name: Tallow
ingredients.summary: Tallow is rendered animal fat used as a cooking fat or ingredient in processed foods.
ingredients.details: Tallow is high in saturated fats, which can contribute to heart disease if consumed in excess. It is often used in baked goods and fried foods.

ingredients.name: Soybean Oil
ingredients.summary: Soybean oil is a vegetable oil commonly used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: Soybean oil is high in omega-6 fatty acids, which can promote inflammation when consumed excessively. It is widely used due to its low cost and versatility.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.summary: Glycerin is a humectant used to retain moisture in foods.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is a sugar alcohol that helps preserve texture and moisture in processed foods. It is generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Processed with Alkali
ingredients.summary: Cocoa processed with alkali is treated to reduce acidity and improve flavor.
ingredients.details: Also known as Dutch-processed cocoa, this ingredient is used in baking and chocolate products. It is safe and enhances the taste of cocoa.

ingredients.name: Food Starch Modified
ingredients.summary: Modified food starch is a processed thickener used in many foods.
ingredients.details: This starch is chemically or physically altered to improve its functionality in processed foods. It is generally safe but provides little nutritional value.

ingredients.name: Corn Starch
ingredients.summary: Corn starch is a natural thickener used in cooking and food production.
ingredients.details: Derived from corn, this ingredient is used to thicken sauces and stabilize processed foods. It is safe but lacks significant nutritional benefits.

ingredients.name: Baking Soda
ingredients.summary: Baking soda is a leavening agent used in baked goods.
ingredients.details: Also known as sodium bicarbonate, baking soda helps dough rise by releasing carbon dioxide. It is safe and widely used in cooking.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.summary: Salt is used to enhance flavor but can contribute to high blood pressure if consumed excessively.
ingredients.details: Sodium chloride is essential for bodily functions but is often overused in processed foods, leading to potential health risks like hypertension and cardiovascular disease.

ingredients.name: Whey
ingredients.summary: Whey is a dairy protein used in food products.
ingredients.details: Derived from milk, whey is a source of protein and is commonly used in baked goods and supplements. It is safe for most people but may cause issues for those with dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Corn Syrup Solids
ingredients.summary: Corn syrup solids are dehydrated corn syrup used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is similar to corn syrup but in powdered form. It adds sweetness and texture to processed foods and can contribute to health issues when consumed excessively.

ingredients.name: Calcium Sulfate
ingredients.summary: Calcium sulfate is a food additive used as a firming agent and preservative.
ingredients.details: This mineral is used to maintain texture and stability in processed foods. It is generally recognized as safe in food applications.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.summary: Eggs are a natural ingredient used for binding and texture in recipes.
ingredients.details: Eggs are a source of protein and nutrients but may pose allergy risks for some individuals. They are commonly used in baked goods and processed foods.

ingredients.name: Agave Syrup
ingredients.summary: Agave syrup is a natural sweetener derived from the agave plant.
ingredients.details: Agave syrup is high in fructose, which can contribute to metabolic issues when consumed in excess. It is often marketed as a healthier alternative to sugar.

ingredients.name: Inulin
ingredients.summary: Inulin is a dietary fiber used to improve texture and promote gut health.
ingredients.details: This fiber is derived from plants and is often added to foods to enhance fiber content. It supports digestion and is generally safe.

ingredients.name: Egg Whites
ingredients.summary: Egg whites are a natural ingredient used for binding and texture.
ingredients.details: Egg whites are a source of protein and are commonly used in baking and processed foods. They are safe but may pose allergy risks for some individuals.

ingredients.name: Dextrose
ingredients.summary: Dextrose is a simple sugar used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: This sugar is derived from corn and is used to add sweetness and improve texture in processed foods. It can contribute to blood sugar spikes when consumed excessively.

ingredients.name: Hydrogenated Tallow
ingredients.summary: Hydrogenated tallow is a processed fat that may contain trans fats.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is made by chemically altering tallow to improve shelf life and texture. Trans fats in hydrogenated fats are linked to heart disease and other health risks.

ingredients.name: Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate
ingredients.summary: Sodium acid pyrophosphate is a leavening agent used in baked goods.
ingredients.details: This chemical helps dough rise and improves texture in processed foods. It is generally safe but may contribute to high sodium intake.

ingredients.name: Mono and Diglycerides
ingredients.summary: Mono and diglycerides are emulsifiers used to improve texture and shelf life.
ingredients.details: These ingredients are derived from fats and are used to stabilize processed foods. They may contain trans fats, which are linked to health risks.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 60
ingredients.summary: Polysorbate 60 is an emulsifier used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: This synthetic compound helps mix ingredients like oil and water. It is generally safe but may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate
ingredients.summary: Sodium stearoyl lactylate is an emulsifier used to improve texture and shelf life.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is commonly used in baked goods and is considered safe in food applications. It helps maintain consistency in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Cottonseed Oil
ingredients.summary: Cottonseed oil is a vegetable oil used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: This oil is high in omega-6 fatty acids, which can promote inflammation when consumed excessively. It is widely used due to its low cost.

ingredients.name: Soy Lecithin
ingredients.summary: Soy lecithin is an emulsifier used to improve texture and mixability in foods.
ingredients.details: Derived from soybeans, this ingredient is widely used in processed foods and is generally safe. It poses allergy risks for individuals sensitive to soy.

ingredients.name: Xanthan Gum
ingredients.summary: Xanthan gum is a thickener and stabilizer used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is produced by fermenting sugars and is used to improve texture and stability in foods. It is safe and widely used in gluten-free products.

ingredients.name: Agar
ingredients.summary: Agar is a natural thickener derived from seaweed.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is used to improve texture and stability in foods. It is safe and often used in vegetarian and vegan products.

ingredients.name: Cellulose Gum
ingredients.summary: Cellulose gum is a thickener and stabilizer used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: Derived from plant fibers, this ingredient is used to improve texture and stability. It is safe and widely used in food production.

ingredients.name: Natural and Artificial Flavors
ingredients.summary: Natural and artificial flavors are used to enhance taste in processed foods.
ingredients.details: Natural flavors are derived from plant or animal sources, while artificial flavors are chemically synthesized. While generally safe, artificial flavors may cause sensitivity in some individuals.

ingredients.name: Color
ingredients.summary: Color additives are used to enhance the appearance of foods.
ingredients.details: Artificial colors may pose health risks, including allergies and hyperactivity in sensitive individuals. Natural colors are generally safer.

ingredients.name: Monocalcium Phosphate
ingredients.summary: Monocalcium phosphate is a leavening agent used in baked goods.
ingredients.details: This ingredient helps dough rise and improves texture in processed foods. It is considered safe in food applications.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.summary: Enzymes are natural proteins used to improve food processing and texture.
ingredients.details: These proteins help break down ingredients and improve texture in processed foods. They are safe and widely used in food production.

ingredients.name: Locust Bean Gum
ingredients.summary: Locust bean gum is a natural thickener derived from carob seeds.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is used to improve texture and stability in foods. It is safe and often used in gluten-free products.

ingredients.name: Dipotassium Phosphate
ingredients.summary: Dipotassium phosphate is a food additive used as a stabilizer and buffering agent.
ingredients.details: This ingredient helps maintain pH balance and improve texture in processed foods. It is generally safe but may contribute to high potassium intake in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Chocolate Liquor
ingredients.summary: Chocolate liquor is a natural ingredient made from ground cacao beans.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is used to provide chocolate flavor in foods. It is safe and contains antioxidants that may offer health benefits.

ingredients.name: Defatted Soy Flour
ingredients.summary: Defatted soy flour is a processed soy product used to improve texture and protein content.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is made by removing fat from soybeans and is used in baked goods and processed foods. It poses allergy risks for individuals sensitive to soy.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.summary: Water is a common solvent used in skincare products.
ingredients.details: Water serves as a base for many formulations, helping to dissolve other ingredients and provide hydration.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.summary: Glycerin is a humectant that helps retain moisture in the skin.
ingredients.details: It is widely used in skincare products to improve hydration by drawing water into the skin from the environment.

ingredients.name: Olive Fruit Oil
ingredients.summary: Olive Fruit Oil is a natural oil that moisturizes and nourishes the skin.
ingredients.details: Rich in antioxidants and fatty acids, it helps protect the skin barrier and improve skin texture.

ingredients.name: Butylene Glycol
ingredients.summary: Butylene Glycol is a solvent and humectant used in skincare formulations.
ingredients.details: It helps improve the texture of products and retains moisture in the skin, making it a common ingredient in cosmetics.

ingredients.name: Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil
ingredients.summary: Macadamia Seed Oil is a natural oil that hydrates and softens the skin.
ingredients.details: It is rich in fatty acids and antioxidants, which help nourish and protect the skin from environmental stressors.

ingredients.name: Cyclopentasiloxane
ingredients.summary: Cyclopentasiloxane is a silicone-based ingredient used for its smoothing properties.
ingredients.details: While it provides a silky texture to products, silicones can sometimes build up on the skin, potentially clogging pores or causing irritation in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Cetearyl Alcohol
ingredients.summary: Cetearyl Alcohol is a fatty alcohol used as an emollient and thickener.
ingredients.details: Unlike drying alcohols, it helps moisturize the skin and stabilize product formulations.

ingredients.name: Beeswax
ingredients.summary: Beeswax is a natural wax used as an emollient and thickening agent.
ingredients.details: It helps lock in moisture and provides a protective barrier on the skin, making it ideal for dry skin formulations.

ingredients.name: Cetyl Ethylhexanoate
ingredients.summary: Cetyl Ethylhexanoate is an emollient that improves skin texture.
ingredients.details: It helps provide a smooth, non-greasy feel to products and enhances their spreadability.

ingredients.name: Cyclohexasiloxane
ingredients.summary: Cyclohexasiloxane is a silicone-based ingredient used for its smoothing properties.
ingredients.details: Similar to other silicones, it can create a silky texture but may build up on the skin, potentially causing irritation or clogged pores.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 60
ingredients.summary: Polysorbate 60 is an emulsifier that helps mix oil and water-based ingredients.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used in skincare formulations to stabilize products and ensure even distribution of ingredients.

ingredients.name: Stearic Acid
ingredients.summary: Stearic Acid is a fatty acid used as an emollient and thickener.
ingredients.details: It helps stabilize formulations and provides a creamy texture while supporting skin hydration.

ingredients.name: Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate
ingredients.summary: Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate is an emulsifier used in skincare products.
ingredients.details: It helps blend oil and water-based ingredients and provides a smooth texture to formulations.

ingredients.name: Isopropyl Myristate
ingredients.summary: Isopropyl Myristate is an emollient that enhances product absorption.
ingredients.details: While it improves the texture and absorption of products, it can sometimes clog pores, making it unsuitable for acne-prone skin.

ingredients.name: PEG-100 Stearate
ingredients.summary: PEG-100 Stearate is an emulsifier derived from polyethylene glycol.
ingredients.details: It helps stabilize formulations but may contain trace amounts of impurities like ethylene oxide or 1,4-dioxane, which are potential carcinogens.

ingredients.name: Glyceryl Stearate
ingredients.summary: Glyceryl Stearate is an emulsifier and emollient used in skincare products.
ingredients.details: It helps improve the texture of formulations and provides hydration to the skin.

ingredients.name: Witch Hazel Extract
ingredients.summary: Witch Hazel Extract is a natural astringent that helps tone the skin.
ingredients.details: It is commonly used to reduce inflammation and tighten pores, making it suitable for oily or acne-prone skin.

ingredients.name: Dimethiconol
ingredients.summary: Dimethiconol is a silicone-based polymer used for its smoothing properties.
ingredients.details: It provides a silky texture and helps lock in moisture, but like other silicones, it may cause buildup on the skin over time.

ingredients.name: Sodium Polyacrylate
ingredients.summary: Sodium Polyacrylate is a thickener and film-forming agent.
ingredients.details: It helps improve the texture of products and provides a protective barrier on the skin.

ingredients.name: 1,2-Hexanediol
ingredients.summary: 1,2-Hexanediol is a humectant and preservative used in skincare products.
ingredients.details: It helps retain moisture in the skin and stabilizes formulations by preventing microbial growth.

ingredients.name: Caprylyl Glycol
ingredients.summary: Caprylyl Glycol is a humectant and preservative used in cosmetics.
ingredients.details: It helps hydrate the skin and enhances the efficacy of other preservatives in formulations.

ingredients.name: Shea Butter
ingredients.summary: Shea Butter is a natural emollient that deeply moisturizes the skin.
ingredients.details: Rich in vitamins and fatty acids, it helps nourish and protect the skin barrier, making it ideal for dry or sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Anise Fruit Extract
ingredients.summary: Anise Fruit Extract is a natural extract with antioxidant properties.
ingredients.details: It helps protect the skin from environmental stressors and may provide a mild soothing effect.

ingredients.name: Disodium EDTA
ingredients.summary: Disodium EDTA is a chelating agent used to stabilize formulations.
ingredients.details: It binds to metal ions to prevent product degradation, but it is a synthetic ingredient that may cause mild irritation in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Betaine
ingredients.summary: Betaine is a humectant that helps hydrate the skin.
ingredients.details: It is derived from sugar beets and helps improve skin moisture levels while reducing irritation.

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.summary: Allantoin is a soothing agent that promotes skin healing.
ingredients.details: It helps reduce irritation and supports the regeneration of damaged skin cells.

ingredients.name: Trehalose
ingredients.summary: Trehalose is a sugar-based humectant that helps retain moisture.
ingredients.details: It protects the skin from dehydration and oxidative stress, making it a beneficial ingredient in skincare products.

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 20
ingredients.summary: Polysorbate 20 is an emulsifier used to mix oil and water-based ingredients.
ingredients.details: It helps stabilize formulations and ensures even distribution of active ingredients.

ingredients.name: Polyglutamic Acid
ingredients.summary: Polyglutamic Acid is a humectant that helps retain moisture in the skin.
ingredients.details: It is known for its ability to hold water, improving skin hydration and elasticity.

ingredients.name: Licorice Root Extract
ingredients.summary: Licorice Root Extract is a natural extract with brightening and soothing properties.
ingredients.details: It helps reduce hyperpigmentation and inflammation, making it suitable for sensitive or uneven skin tones.

ingredients.name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
ingredients.summary: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract is a natural antioxidant derived from green tea.
ingredients.details: It helps protect the skin from free radical damage and has soothing properties, making it ideal for sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Rosemary Leaf Extract
ingredients.summary: Rosemary Leaf Extract is a natural antioxidant with antimicrobial properties.
ingredients.details: It helps protect the skin from environmental stressors and supports product preservation.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica Extract
ingredients.summary: Centella Asiatica Extract is a natural extract known for its soothing and healing properties.
ingredients.details: It helps reduce inflammation and promotes skin repair, making it ideal for sensitive or damaged skin.

ingredients.name: Matricaria Flower Extract
ingredients.summary: Matricaria Flower Extract is a natural extract with soothing and anti-inflammatory properties.
ingredients.details: Derived from chamomile, it helps calm irritated skin and supports skin healing.

ingredients.name: Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract
ingredients.summary: Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract is a natural antioxidant with anti-inflammatory properties.
ingredients.details: It helps protect the skin from oxidative stress and reduces redness or irritation.

ingredients.name: Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract
ingredients.summary: Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract is a natural antioxidant with soothing properties.
ingredients.details: It helps protect the skin from environmental damage and supports skin health.

ingredients.name: Xylitol
ingredients.summary: Xylitol is a sugar alcohol used as a humectant in skincare products.
ingredients.details: It helps retain moisture in the skin and improves hydration levels.

ingredients.name: Ceramide NP
ingredients.summary: Ceramide NP is a lipid molecule that strengthens the skin barrier.
ingredients.details: It helps retain moisture and protects the skin from external irritants, making it ideal for dry or sensitive skin.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.summary: Citric Acid is an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) used to adjust pH and exfoliate the skin.
ingredients.details: It helps remove dead skin cells and improves product stability by balancing pH levels.

ingredients.name: Palm Oil
ingredients.summary: Palm oil is a type of vegetable oil commonly used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: Palm oil is high in saturated fats, which may contribute to heart disease when consumed in excess. Additionally, its production raises environmental concerns due to deforestation.

ingredients.name: Canola Oil
ingredients.summary: Canola oil is a vegetable oil derived from rapeseed.
ingredients.details: Canola oil is considered a healthy oil due to its low saturated fat content and high omega-3 fatty acids. It is widely used in cooking and food production.

ingredients.name: Soy Lecithin
ingredients.summary: Soy lecithin is an emulsifier derived from soybeans.
ingredients.details: Soy lecithin helps blend ingredients like oil and water. It is generally safe for consumption but may pose a risk for individuals allergic to soy.

ingredients.name: Wheat Flour
ingredients.summary: Wheat flour is a common ingredient made from ground wheat.
ingredients.details: Wheat flour contains gluten, which can cause adverse reactions in individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity. It is a staple in many baked goods.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.summary: Sugar is a sweetener commonly used in food products.
ingredients.details: Excessive sugar consumption is linked to health issues such as obesity, diabetes, and heart disease. It is often added to enhance flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.summary: Salt is a mineral used as a seasoning and preservative.
ingredients.details: High sodium intake is associated with increased blood pressure and cardiovascular risks. It is widely used in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Corn Starch
ingredients.summary: Corn starch is a thickening agent derived from corn.
ingredients.details: Corn starch is commonly used to improve texture in sauces and baked goods. It is generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.summary: Spices are natural flavoring agents derived from plants.
ingredients.details: Spices are used to enhance the flavor of food and are generally safe. Specific spices may have health benefits or allergenic potential.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.summary: Garlic is a bulb used for flavoring and medicinal purposes.
ingredients.details: Garlic is known for its strong flavor and potential health benefits, including antimicrobial properties and heart health support.

ingredients.name: Whole Milk Powder
ingredients.summary: Whole milk powder is dehydrated milk.
ingredients.details: Whole milk powder contains lactose and dairy proteins, which can be problematic for individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Skim Milk Powder
ingredients.summary: Skim milk powder is dehydrated milk with reduced fat content.
ingredients.details: Skim milk powder is used in processed foods and contains lactose, which may cause issues for lactose-intolerant individuals.

ingredients.name: Caramel Color
ingredients.summary: Caramel color is a food coloring made by heating sugar.
ingredients.details: Caramel color is used to enhance the appearance of foods. Some types may contain compounds linked to health concerns such as carcinogenicity.

ingredients.name: Monosodium Glutamate
ingredients.summary: MSG is a flavor enhancer commonly used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: MSG enhances savory flavors but may cause sensitivity in some individuals, leading to headaches or nausea. It is generally recognized as safe by regulatory agencies.

ingredients.name: Defatted Soybean
ingredients.summary: Defatted soybean is soy with reduced fat content.
ingredients.details: Defatted soybean is used in food products as a protein source. It is safe for consumption but may cause issues for soy-allergic individuals.

ingredients.name: Yeast Extract
ingredients.summary: Yeast extract is a flavor enhancer derived from yeast.
ingredients.details: Yeast extract is used to add umami flavor to foods. It is generally safe but may contain naturally occurring glutamates.

ingredients.name: Natural and Artificial Flavors
ingredients.summary: Natural and artificial flavors are additives used to enhance taste.
ingredients.details: Natural flavors are derived from plants or animals, while artificial flavors are chemically synthesized. Some artificial flavors may pose health concerns.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.summary: Honey is a natural sweetener made by bees.
ingredients.details: Honey is a healthier alternative to refined sugar and contains trace nutrients. It should be avoided by infants due to the risk of botulism.

ingredients.name: Dextrin
ingredients.summary: Dextrin is a carbohydrate used as a thickener or stabilizer.
ingredients.details: Dextrin is derived from starch and is generally safe for consumption. It is commonly used in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Pasteurized Milk
ingredients.summary: Pasteurized milk is heat-treated to kill bacteria.
ingredients.details: Pasteurized milk is safe for most people but contains lactose, which may cause issues for lactose-intolerant individuals.

ingredients.name: Cheese Cultures
ingredients.summary: Cheese cultures are bacteria used in cheese production.
ingredients.details: Cheese cultures help ferment milk to produce cheese. They are safe for consumption and essential for cheese flavor development.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.summary: Enzymes are proteins used to catalyze chemical reactions in food production.
ingredients.details: Enzymes are commonly used in baking and dairy processing. They are safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Onion Flake
ingredients.summary: Onion flakes are dehydrated onion pieces.
ingredients.details: Onion flakes are used to add flavor to foods and are generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Onion Extract
ingredients.summary: Onion extract is a concentrated form of onion flavor.
ingredients.details: Onion extract is used to enhance flavor in processed foods. It is safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.summary: Soy sauce is a fermented condiment made from soybeans, wheat, and salt.
ingredients.details: Soy sauce contains high sodium levels and gluten, which may pose risks for individuals with hypertension or gluten sensitivity.

ingredients.name: Tomato Powder
ingredients.summary: Tomato powder is dehydrated tomato used as a flavoring agent.
ingredients.details: Tomato powder is used to add tomato flavor to foods. It is generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Dried Onion
ingredients.summary: Dried onion is dehydrated onion used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: Dried onion is safe for consumption and commonly used in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Glucose
ingredients.summary: Glucose is a simple sugar used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: Excessive glucose consumption can lead to health issues such as obesity and diabetes. It is often added to processed foods.

ingredients.name: Sucrose Fatty Acid Esters
ingredients.summary: Sucrose fatty acid esters are emulsifiers used in food production.
ingredients.details: These compounds help blend ingredients like oil and water. They are generally recognized as safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.summary: Banana is a natural fruit used for flavor and nutrition.
ingredients.details: Bananas are a good source of potassium and vitamins. They are safe for most individuals.

ingredients.name: Processed Honey
ingredients.summary: Processed honey is a refined form of honey.
ingredients.details: Processed honey is used as a sweetener but may lose some nutrients during processing. It is safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Tomato Paste
ingredients.summary: Tomato paste is concentrated tomato used for flavoring.
ingredients.details: Tomato paste is safe for consumption and commonly used in sauces and soups.

ingredients.name: Fermented Milk
ingredients.summary: Fermented milk is milk that has undergone fermentation.
ingredients.details: Fermented milk contains probiotics but may pose issues for lactose-intolerant individuals. It is commonly used in dairy products.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.summary: Citric acid is a natural acid used as a preservative and flavor enhancer.
ingredients.details: Citric acid is widely used in processed foods and beverages. It is safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Mono- and Diglycerides
ingredients.summary: Mono- and diglycerides are emulsifiers used in food production.
ingredients.details: These compounds help stabilize mixtures of oil and water. They may contain trans fats, which are linked to heart disease.

ingredients.name: Processed with Alkali
ingredients.summary: Processed with alkali refers to the use of alkaline substances in food production.
ingredients.details: This process is used to modify texture and flavor in foods like cocoa. It is generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Tomato Extract
ingredients.summary: Tomato extract is a concentrated form of tomato flavor.
ingredients.details: Tomato extract is used to enhance flavor in processed foods. It is safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Soy Protein Hydrolysate
ingredients.summary: Soy protein hydrolysate is a processed form of soy protein.
ingredients.details: This ingredient is used as a protein source and flavor enhancer. It may cause issues for individuals with soy allergies.

ingredients.name: Apple Puree
ingredients.summary: Apple puree is a natural fruit ingredient used for flavor and texture.
ingredients.details: Apple puree is safe for consumption and adds natural sweetness and fiber to foods.

ingredients.name: Maltose
ingredients.summary: Maltose is a sugar used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: Excessive maltose consumption can contribute to health issues like obesity and diabetes. It is commonly used in processed foods.

ingredients.name: Whey Powder
ingredients.summary: Whey powder is a dairy protein derived from milk.
ingredients.details: Whey powder is used as a protein source but may cause issues for individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy allergies.

ingredients.name: Garlic Flake
ingredients.summary: Garlic flakes are dehydrated garlic pieces.
ingredients.details: Garlic flakes are used to add flavor to foods and are generally safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Paprika Color
ingredients.summary: Paprika color is a natural coloring derived from paprika.
ingredients.details: Paprika color is used to enhance the appearance of foods. It is safe for consumption.

ingredients.name: Disodium Inosinate
ingredients.summary: Disodium inosinate is a flavor enhancer used in processed foods.
ingredients.details: This additive enhances savory flavors but may cause sensitivity in some individuals. It is often used in combination with MSG.
